name: environment
argv:
source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh
set -e
cjc --version
cjpm --version
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short

name: unchanged-contract-check
argv:
source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh
set -e
git diff --check
git diff --exit-code bfd0715cc342fe7c334bd7ce222cdda9c4fb37d5 -- src native build.cj cjpm.toml tests/glyphs/pty.mjs tests/glyphs/internal tests/glyphs/api tests/glyphs/public tests/glyphs/rich tests/glyphs/negative tests/glyphs/negative.sh tests/glyphs/README.md tests/glyphs/run.sh tests/glyphs/session/native tests/glyphs/session/cjpm.toml
git diff --name-only
git diff -- tests/glyphs/session/src/main.cj

name: precommit-check
argv:
source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh
set -e
git diff --cached --check
git diff --cached --stat
git diff --exit-code bfd0715cc342fe7c334bd7ce222cdda9c4fb37d5 -- src native build.cj cjpm.toml tests/glyphs/pty.mjs tests/glyphs/session/native
git status --short

name: final-verification
argv:
source /workspace/work/validation/sdk/cangjie/envsetup.sh
set -e
sha256sum -c /workspace/work/glyph-tests-refresh/capture-report/sourcehash.sha256
git diff --exit-code
git diff --cached --exit-code
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git diff --exit-code bfd0715cc342fe7c334bd7ce222cdda9c4fb37d5 HEAD -- src native build.cj cjpm.toml
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD
git rev-parse HEAD
